title: SDSC Bundle JSON Schema
description: JSON Schema for SDSC Bundle format. This schema covers compute operations (SFP, matmul, BMM, identity) and data operations (transpose, slice).
$comment: Version History: v1.0.0 - Initial schema. v1.0.1 (2026-05-11) - Corrected dsType_ enum to match torch_spyre constants: INPUT, OUTPUT, KERNEL, KERNEL_IDX. v1.1.0 (2026-05-XX) - Added symbolic representation: SymbolicDimInfo def, DimPaddingSizes def, DataStructDims.symbolicDimInfo_/dims_/paddingSizes_, SuperDsc symbolic fields (dimToSymbolMappingOpcodeCorrection_, inputSymbolsAndTags_, symbolDefinitions_), DesignSpaceConfig.dimToSymbolMapping_, ScheduleTreeNode.isStartAddrSymbolic_. v1.1.1 (2026-07-07) - Allow isStartAddrSymbolic_ to accept integer 0/1 in addition to boolean false/true. v1.1.2 (2026-07-07) - Allow DataStructDims direct dimension fields to accept empty object {} in addition to integer >= 1. v1.2.0 (2026-07-08) - Sync DataStructDims/DimPaddingSizes/SymbolicDimInfo with deeptools-schema.json v1.3.0 (source: dsc/dims.h + dsc/dims.cpp exportJson()): DataStructDims: added explicit dim fields (in_, out_, mb_, i_, j_, ki_, kj_, x_, x1_, y_, r_, c_, ij_, rc_, kij_, sij_, zij_, si_, sj_, zi_, zj_), added coreletSplit_, rowSplit_, peSfpSplit_, maxSymbolicVolume_, removed spurious dims_ field. DimPaddingSizes: corrected frontPadding_->padFront_, backPadding_->padBack_, removed kernelDim_, added unneededPad_, unneededPadFront_, unneededPadBack_, totalSize_, dilation_, windowDim_. SymbolicDimInfo: corrected maxValue_->maxSize_. dataStageParam_ per-stage object: added name_ field.

SuperDsc.description: Bundle-level configuration for multi-core accelerator operation.

dimToSymbolMappingOpcodeCorrection_.description: Symbol mapping corrections for opcode generation

inputSymbolsAndTags_.description: Input symbols and their associated tags

debug_handle_.description: Source-to-kernel provenance for this SuperDsc, emitted by the frontend. null is a normal value, not missing data. Not read by the deeptools loader -- it exists for tooling that maps a kernel back to its source. See DebugHandle.

datadscs_.description: Data-operation DSCs (transpose, slice, ...) attached to this SuperDsc. Emitted by the frontend only when symbolic dims are present, always as an empty array; the loader imports each element as a DataOpDsc. Element contents are outside this curated set.

coreIdToDsc_.description: Mapping from core ID to DSC index

numWkSlicesPerDim_.description: Number of work slices per dimension

coreIdToWkSlice_.description: Mapping from core ID to work slice indices

coreIdToDscSchedule.description: Per-core execution schedule. Each value is an array of step tuples [datadsc_idx, dldsc_idx, before_sync, after_sync]: data DSC index, data-load DSC index, barrier before step (0=none), barrier after step (0=none).

DebugHandle.description: Source-to-kernel provenance handle, nestable to mirror MLIR locations. Produced by the frontend's DebugHandle serializer. A null source or aten_op is a normal value: when an op fuses origins from several source lines there is no single headline, and the full set is preserved in fused_from.

id.description: Handle id. Serialized as a string because a 63-bit value exceeds JS Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER and would be rounded by JSON.parse.

source.description: Headline source location, or null when the op fuses several origins.

aten_op.description: Originating ATen op name, or null when the op fuses several origins.

fused_from.description: Handles this one was fused from. Recursive.

transform_history.description: Structured lower-IR rewrites applied to this op.

SourceLoc.description: Structured source location. Field names mirror MLIR FileLineColRange so a future KTIR migration maps 1:1.

ProvenanceTransform.description: One structured lower-IR transformation in a provenance history.

FoldProperty.description: Pairs a fold factor with a memory hierarchy level label. Used in SuperDsc (coreFoldProp_, coreletFoldProp_, sdscFoldProps_) and FoldManager (dim_prop_attr) to describe how data is partitioned across cores, corelets, and time steps.

factor_.description: Iteration extent of this fold dimension: legal indices are 0 .. factor_-1, and FoldManager::isLegal errors on any index >= factor_. 1 = no splitting. Minimum 1 is therefore correct -- factor_ 0 admits no index at all, so the dimension cannot be read. Known frontend bug: elem_arr_1 is emitted as a whole-stick count (size divided by elements-per-stick, rounding down), which underflows to 0 for a dimension smaller than one stick -- but factor_ is an index extent, so it must round up. The gather/scatter fixtures under dxp/test carry the bad value and fail validation until the frontend is corrected.

FoldManager.description: Encodes a multi-dimensional fold expression mapping loop index tuples (core, corelet, time step) to concrete values (addresses, coordinates, constants). Used in SuperDsc.sdscFolds_, ScheduleTreeNode.startAddressCoreCorelet_, CoordinateInfo.folds, and ConstantInfo.data_.

dim_prop_func.description: One fold function per dimension (same length as dim_prop_attr). Each element is a single-key object: Const (same value for all indices), Map (lookup in data_), Affine (alpha*index+beta), or WkSplit (work-slice index from coreIdToWkSlice_).

dim_prop_attr.description: One FoldProperty per dimension (same length as dim_prop_func). Gives the fold level label and factor for each dimension.

data_.description: Lookup table keyed by fold-coordinate tuples (e.g. '[0, 1]'). Values are strings (symbolic or numeric addresses), integers, or arrays of integers. Only needed when dim_prop_func contains Map or Const entries.

WrappedDesignSpaceConfig.description: DSC wrapped in operation name key - used in dscs_ array

DesignSpaceConfig.description: Complete description of a single compute configuration executed by one or more Spyre cores. Holds tensor dimensions, tensor descriptors, memory allocation schedule, and compute operations. Appears as the value of each entry in SuperDsc.dscs_.

numCoresUsed_.description: Number of Spyre cores used by this DSC. Must match the length of coreIdsUsed_.

coreIdsUsed_.description: IDs of the cores that execute this DSC. Length must equal numCoresUsed_.

N_.description: Total (un-tiled) tensor dimensions for this operation.

dimToSymbolMapping_.description: Mapping from dimensions to symbolic variables

coordinateMasking_.description: Coordinate masking configuration for masked operations.

maskingConstId_.description: Index into constantInfo_ of the masking constant, or -1 when the operation has none. -1 is DesignSpaceConfig::maskingConstId_'s default and is the common case.

pdsRelation_.description: Relationships between the primary data structures. Emitted by the frontend for pool/window ops and read by DesignSpaceConfig::importJsonObj.

isPdsReuse.description: 1 = the input and output primary data structures share storage.

dataStageParam_.description: Data staging parameters per core. Each value has ss_ (steady-state dimensions) and el_ (epilogue dimensions).

primaryDsInfo_.description: Physical memory layout per tensor role (INPUT, OUTPUT, KERNEL, KERNEL_IDX). Each key is an uppercase tensor-role label; the value is a PrimaryDsInfo object specifying layout order, stick dimensions, and stick sizes. Keys must match dsType_ values used in labeledDs_.

^[A-Z_]+$.description: Layout information for one tensor role. layoutDimOrder_ lists dimensions outermost-first; stickDimOrder_ and stickSize_ are parallel arrays defining the innermost contiguous storage tile.

layoutDimOrder_.description: Ordered list of dimension names describing how the tensor is laid out in memory, outermost first. Dimension names must match those declared in DataStructDims.

stickDimOrder_.description: The innermost contiguous dimensions that form a stick — the atomic unit of storage transfer. Must be a suffix subset of layoutDimOrder_. Parallel to stickSize_.

stickSize_.description: Size of each stick dimension in elements. Parallel to stickDimOrder_: stickSize_[i] is the element count for stickDimOrder_[i].

stickRepl_.description: Per-stick-dimension replication counts, parallel to stickDimOrder_. Emitted by the frontend for pool/window ops and read by DesignSpaceConfig::importJsonObj. Defaults to all-ones when absent.

scheduleTree_.description: Ordered list of memory allocation and compute schedule nodes.

labeledDs_.description: Descriptors for all tensors (input and output) used by this DSC.

oneOf.description: Named constants used by the operation, keyed by string integer index.
Set to the string '{}' when the operation has no constants.

computeOp_.description: Compute operations to execute. More than one entry when operations are fused.

DataStructDims.description: Data structure dimensions. Serialized by DataStructDims::exportJson() in dsc/dims.cpp. All numeric dim values are doubles (default -1 = unset). Primary dims (in_, out_, mb_, i_, j_, ki_, kj_, x_, x1_, y_) are always serialized. Deprecated dims (r_, c_, ij_, rc_, kij_, sij_, zij_, si_, sj_, zi_, zj_) are serialized unless skipDeprecatedFields=true.

x_.description: Repeat dim that does not add reuse (e.g. attention heads). -1 = unset.

x1_.description: Additional repeat dim (e.g. attention heads). -1 = unset.

r_.description: [deprecated] Input image rows with zero padding. -1 = unset.

c_.description: [deprecated] Input image cols with zero padding. -1 = unset.

rc_.description: [deprecated] Input image rows/cols with zero padding. -1 = unset.

symbolicDimInfo_.description: Per-dimension symbolic size info. Keys are primary dim names (e.g. 'in_', 'mb_'); values are SymbolicDimInfo objects.

maxSymbolicVolume_.description: Maximum combined symbolic volume for a set of symbolic dims. Keys are dim-set arrays encoded as strings (e.g. '["in_","mb_"]'); values are integer max volumes.

coreletSplit_.description: Per-dimension explicit work split across corelets. Keys are primary dim names; values are arrays of integer work sizes, one entry per corelet.

rowSplit_.description: Per-dimension, per-corelet explicit work split across PT rows. Keys are primary dim names; values are objects keyed by corelet id (numeric string) whose values are arrays of integer work sizes per PT row.

peSfpSplit_.description: Per-dimension, per-corelet work split between PE and SFP components. Keys are primary dim names; values are objects keyed by corelet id (numeric string) whose values are objects mapping component name (e.g. 'pe', 'sfp') to integer work size.

paddingSizes_.description: Per-dimension padding information. Keys are primary dim names (e.g. 'r_', 'c_'); values are DimPaddingSizes objects.

ScheduleTreeNode.description: One step in the ordered execution plan for a DesignSpaceConfig. Each node allocates a tensor in a specific memory component. Nodes are linked by prev_ to form a dependency chain and reference tensors via ldsIdx_ into labeledDs_.

nodeType_.description: Type of schedule node. Currently only 'allocate' is supported.

name_.description: Unique identifier for this node within the scheduleTree_ array. Referenced by other nodes via prev_.

prev_.description: Name of the predecessor node, establishing execution ordering. Omit for the first node in the tree.

ldsIdx_.description: Zero-based index into the parent labeledDs_ array identifying which tensor this node allocates. See LabeledDataStructure.

component_.description: Target memory component for the allocation. 'hbm' = high-bandwidth memory; 'lx' = LX scratchpad.

layoutDimOrder_.description: Physical memory layout order for this allocation, outermost first. Overrides the global primaryDsInfo_ layout when present.

maxDimSizes_.description: Maximum element count per dimension, parallel to layoutDimOrder_. Used to size the allocated buffer.

isStartAddrSymbolic_.description: When true, start addresses are expressed as symbolic values rather than concrete byte offsets. Written by the backend compiler when symbolic addressing is required. Accepts boolean true/false or integer 1/0.

startAddressCoreCorelet_.description: Per-core / per-corelet start address for this allocation, encoded as a FoldManager. See FoldManager for the full encoding.

backGapCore_.description: Back-gap size in elements per dimension per core. Written by the backend compiler when tensor.backGap is true. Outer key is a dimension name; inner key is a core ID (as a decimal string); value is the gap size as a decimal string.

padding_.description: Padding parameters for this allocation. Written by the backend compiler when the tensor requires memory padding beyond its logical size.

indirectAllocType_.description: Indirect allocation type tag. Present when this node participates in an indirect-access allocation pattern.

relatedIndirectAccessAlloc_.description: Name of the related indirect-access allocation node. Must match another node's name_ field, linking this node to its paired indirect access entry.

indexTensorType_.description: How an index tensor's elements are interpreted: 'index' = element indices, 'address' = precomputed addresses. Emitted only when indirectAllocType_ is 'index_tensor'. Both values of AllocateNode::IndexTensorType (dsc/dsc2.h) are accepted, matching the loader.

coordinates_.description: Spatial tiling coordinates for this allocation. Groups per-dimension CoordinateInfo alongside the coreIdToWkSlice_ mapping. See CoordinateContainer.

coordInfo.description: Per-dimension coordinate information. Keys are dimension names (pattern ^[a-z_][a-z0-9_]*$). Each value is a CoordinateInfo object.

coreIdToWkSlice_.description: Maps each core ID (as a string integer key) to a map of dimension name → work-slice index assigned to that core for that dimension.

padding.description: Padding type, from the PadType enum (string mapping in EnumsConversion::padTypeToString).

MemorySlot.description: Memory slot presence and padding flags for a single memory type (HBM or LX).

isPresent.description: 1 = tensor resides in this memory, 0 = absent

isPadded.description: 1 = allocation includes padding. See DimPaddingSizes for padding details.

isZeroPadded.description: 1 = padded region is zero-filled. Only meaningful when isPadded is 1.

dsOffset.description: Byte offset of this tensor within its allocation. Emitted alongside allocateNode_ for every non-depthwise op; part of the general memOrg contract.

allocateNode_.description: Name of the ScheduleTreeNode that allocates this tensor in this memory. Must match that node's name_ field.

MemoryOrganization.description: Memory residency specification for a tensor. Controls whether the tensor is allocated in High Bandwidth Memory (HBM), the per-core LX scratchpad, or both. Appears as memOrg_ inside LabeledDataStructure.

LabeledDataStructure.description: Labeled data structure definition. Describes a single physical tensor (input, output, kernel, or index tensor) used by a DesignSpaceConfig. Both input and output tensors must appear in labeledDs_. Referenced from ScheduleTreeNode.ldsIdx_ and from computeOp_ as '<dsName_>-idx<ldsIdx_>'.

dsName_.description: Unique tensor name within the DSC. Compute ops reference this tensor as '<dsName_>-idx<ldsIdx_>' (e.g. 'convolution-Tensor0-idx0').

dsType_.description: Data structure type (from torch_spyre LAYOUT_INPUT_LABELS and LAYOUT_OUTPUT_LABELS)

wordLength.description: Word length in bytes. Fractional for sub-byte formats: the 4-bit types (SENINT4, SEN121_FP4) carry 0.5, so this is a number rather than an integer. Must be > 0.

dataFormat_.description: Data format. Values are the DataFormats enum names accepted by FromString<DataFormats>() in util/sendefs/sendefs.h; INVALID is excluded because it is that converter's error sentinel, not an input format.

memOrg_.description: Memory organization — specifies which memories (HBM, LX scratchpad) hold this tensor.

ComputeOperation.description: Describes a single compute op executed on the Spyre device. Appears in the computeOp_ array of DesignSpaceConfig. Tensor references in inputLabeledDs and outputLabeledDs use the '<dsName_>-idx<ldsIdx_>' composite key from LabeledDataStructure.

exUnit.description: Execution unit. 'sfp' = Spyre Floating Point unit; 'pt' = Processing Tile array.

opFuncName.description: Operation function name as generated by torch-spyre. See https://torch-spyre.readthedocs.io/ for the full list.

fidelity_.description: Computation fidelity, from the OpAttributes::Fidelity enum (string mapping in OpAttributes::fidelityToString).

location.description: Name of the loop the op executes in, from the LoopNames enum (string mapping in DesignSpaceConfig::loopNameToString). The loader accepts all 32 loop names, but only 'Inner' (the innermost loop) is supported in this curated set -- it is the only value the torch-spyre frontend emits.

inputLabeledDs.description: Input tensor references from labeledDs_ using the '<dsName_>-idx<N>' naming convention.

outputLabeledDs.description: Output tensor references from labeledDs_ using the '<dsName_>-idx<N>' naming convention.

indirectAccessIndexLabeledDs.description: Index tensors for indirect access operations (gather/scatter). See ScheduleTreeNode.indirectAllocType_.

interimLabeledDs.description: Intermediate tensors used within the operation, not exposed as inputs or outputs.

DimPaddingSizes.description: Padding sizes for a single dimension. Source: struct DimPaddingSizes in dsc/dims.h; serialized by DataStructDims::exportJson() in dsc/dims.cpp.

totalSize_.description: Computed total padded size. The string 'N/A' when windowDim_ is unset and padFront_ < 0.

windowDim_.description: Associated window primary dim name (e.g. 'kij_'). Uses primaryDimToString mapping.

SymbolicDimInfo.description: Symbolic dimension info for runtime-variable dimensions. Source: struct SymbolicDimInfo in dsc/dims.h.

maxSize_.description: Maximum value of this symbolic dimension.

granularity_.description: Step granularity of this symbolic dimension.

ConstantInfo.description: Named typed constant used by a DesignSpaceConfig operation (e.g. scaling factor, clip bound). Value is encoded as a FoldManager so it can vary per-core or per-time-step. Appears as values of constantInfo_ in DesignSpaceConfig, keyed by string integer.

name_.description: Unique constant name within the DSC (e.g. 'scaling_factor', 'eps'). Referenced by operations that consume it.

dataFormat_.description: Numeric format of the constant elements. Must match the data format of the tensors the constant is applied to. Same value set as LabeledDataStructure.dataFormat_ (see util/sendefs/sendefs.h FromString<DataFormats>()).

data_.description: Constant value(s) encoded as a fold structure. Allows different values per-core or per-time-step.
